mapper.select: SELECT A.PRODSPEC_ID,A.FLOW_KEY,A.FROM_OPE_NO,A.TO_OPE_NO,A.OPER_NO,A.OPER_SEQ ,CASE WHEN A.OPER_SEQ=A.FROM_OPE_SEQ AND B.PRODSPEC_ID IS NOT NULL THEN '*'||A.QTIME_SPEC WHEN A.OPER_SEQ=A.TO_OPE_SEQ AND C.PRODSPEC_ID IS NOT NULL THEN A.QTIME_SPEC||TO_CHAR(A.QTIME_LIMIT) ELSE A.QTIME_SPEC END QTIME_SPEC FROM ( SELECT PRODSPEC_ID,FLOW_KEY,FROM_OPE_NO,TO_OPE_NO,OPER_NO,OPER_SEQ,QTIME_LIMIT,FROM_OPE_SEQ,TO_OPE_SEQ ,CASE WHEN OPER_SEQ=FROM_OPE_SEQ THEN TO_CHAR(QTIME_LIMIT) WHEN OPER_SEQ=TO_OPE_SEQ THEN '*' ELSE NULL END QTIME_SPEC FROM PWEB.QTIME_FLOW WHERE PRODSPEC_ID=#{prodspec_ID} AND FLOW_KEY=#{flow_KEY} AND FROM_OPE_NO=#{tri_openo} AND TO_OPE_NO=#{tar_openo} )A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODSPEC_ID,FLOW_KEY FROM PWEB.QTIME_FLOW WHERE PRODSPEC_ID=#{prodspec_ID} AND FLOW_KEY=#{flow_KEY} AND TO_OPE_NO=#{tri_openo} GROUP BY PRODSPEC_ID,FLOW_KEY )B ON A.PRODSPEC_ID=B.PRODSPEC_ID AND A.FLOW_KEY=B.FLOW_KEY LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODSPEC_ID,FLOW_KEY FROM PWEB.QTIME_FLOW WHERE PRODSPEC_ID=#{prodspec_ID} AND FLOW_KEY=#{flow_KEY} AND FROM_OPE_NO=#{tar_openo} GROUP BY PRODSPEC_ID,FLOW_KEY )C ON A.PRODSPEC_ID=C.PRODSPEC_ID AND A.FLOW_KEY=C.FLOW_KEY ORDER BY A.OPER_SEQ
